fields.name: icao
fields.description: {"value":"ICAO hexadecimal identifier for the aircraft's transponder code used in flight tracking.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: r
fields.description: {"value":"Registration number of the helicopter, often the tail number.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: aircraft_type
fields.description: {"value":"Type model of the aircraft, specific to Bell helicopters.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: desc_
fields.description: {"value":"Detailed description or model name of the Bell helicopter variant.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: start_height_agl_ft
fields.description: {"value":"Altitude in feet above ground level where the flight segment started.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: end_height_agl_ft
fields.description: {"value":"Altitude in feet above ground level where the flight segment ended.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: start_t
fields.description: {"value":"Start time of the flight segment recorded as a date and time timestamp.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: end_t
fields.description: {"value":"End time of the flight segment recorded as a date and time timestamp.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: geometry_Length
fields.description: {"value":"Length of the flight path geometry, representing the distance flown in the segment.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: DateOfFlight
fields.description: {"value":"Date when the flight took place, without specific time information.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: Speed
fields.description: {"value":"Approximate speed of the helicopter in miles per hour, calculated from spatial and temporal data.","fieldValueType":"countOrAmount"}

fields.name: dateonlyutc
fields.description: {"value":"Date of flight in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), without time details.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}
